title: Physical AI Product Manager
hiring_location: US, CA, Santa Clara, US, CA, Remote
jd_excerpt:
NVIDIA Cosmos Curator is an open-source, GPU-accelerated framework for preparing training data for physical AI. It helps teams process video and sensor recordings, generate annotations and embeddings, and select useful examples for robotics, autonomous vehicles, and world foundation models. The platform is evolving around reusable components, multimodal sensor processing, metadata-rich datasets, and distributed execution that makes productive use of shared GPU infrastructure. 
 We are looking for a deeply technical Product Manager to lead high-impact initiatives across Cosmos Curator. Working with product and engineering leadership, you will connect customer needs and research advances to a focused roadmap, then drive delivery and adoption. This senior individual-contributor role combines platform product development, internal and external customer partnerships, and ecosystem growth. Your judgment will determine which capabilities to build, what to ship first, and how to turn successful experiments into repeatable production use. 
 What you will be doing: 
 Shape product strategy and own prioritized initiatives from discovery through release and adoption. Define requirements, minimum viable scope, success measures, and trade-offs that align engineering, research, and business stakeholders. 
 Build deep partnerships with external customers and internal NVIDIA teams across robotics, autonomous vehicles, and world models. Work with Solutions Architects and Developer Relations to identify adoption blockers, validate solutions, and move trials into production. 
 Expand multimodal and model capabilities with engineering and research. Prioritize sensor formats, timestamp alignment, calibration handling, model integrations, and data-processing algorithms against concrete customer needs and measurable output quality. 
 Own product priorities for performance, reliability, and hardware support. Establish benchmarks for throughput, cost, annotation quality, and recovery; guide investment in observability, efficient model execution, and orchestration across shared GPU infrastructure. 
 Develop partnerships with external parties. Turn integrations & feature requests into reusable product capabilities and help build an open-source ecosystem that extends sensor, model, and pipeline coverage. 
 Partner with engineering, research, marketing, and Developer Relations in exploring new use cases and bringing them to market through validated examples, deployment mentorship, technical content, and launches grounded in customer results. 
 What we need to see: 
 BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 12+ years of combined engineering, applied research, and product experience, including 5+ years in product management for AI/ML, deep-tech, autonomy, or related Physical AI fields. 
 A record of taking complex technical products from customer discovery to shipped capabilities and sustained adoption, with clear ownership of requirements, prioritization, and outcomes. 
 Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, such as physical AI, multimodal data, large-scale data processing, or GPU infrastructure, with the ability to make sound product decisions across adjacent areas. 
 Hands-on technical proficiency: read Python, explore datasets, and build small prototypes to test assumptions and evaluate the developer experience. Communicate effectively with senior engineers and researchers about architecture and trade-offs. 
 Experience working directly with customers and research or engineering partners. Ability to reconcile competing needs, influence across organizations, and communicate a clear product direction to developers and executives. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Prior work in robotics, autonomous vehicles, computer vision, sensor systems, or world-model training, with practical understanding of how data quality affects model performance. 
 Experience with distributed processing, model serving, or data infrastructure such as Ray, Slurm, Lance, and GPU-accelerated pipelines. 
 Applied technical work demonstrated through useful prototypes, production deployments, open-source contributions, technical writing, or research publications; familiarity with NVIDIA Cosmos and other Physical AI-relevant AI models. 
 NVIDIA is widely considered one of the most sought-after employers in the technology world. If you are creative, technically curious, and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
 NVIDIA provides attractive compensation and an extensive benefits package. As you consider your future, explore what we provide for you and your loved ones at www.nvidiabenefits.com/ 
 #LI-Hybrid
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
195,000 USD – 377,000 USD for Level 5; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 6. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
 Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 28, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
